scripts.format: npm -w server run format && npm -w client run format
scripts.lint: npm -w server run lint || true && npm -w client run lint || true
scripts.test: npm -w server run test || echo "No server tests" && npm -w client run test || echo "No client tests"

server/**/*.{js,json}: npm -w server run lint --silent || echo "lint skipped"
client/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,json}: npm -w client run lint --silent || echo "lint skipped"
